name: Froslass
description: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the target.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Wake-Up Slap
moves.description: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.description: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat- changing move the foe attempts to use.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
